title: Telegram routes
description: The routes of Settings › Notifications › Telegram (decision 0009 slice B; docs/notifications/telegram.md), a signed-in person's only, never an access key's. All are additions to /api/v1.

empty.description: The body of POST /api/v1/notify/telegram/pair, /start, /recheck and /disconnect: nothing.

token.description: POST /api/v1/notify/telegram/token: the token BotFather gave (d11 (b)). Telegram must accept it (getMe) before it is kept, in the file telegram.token in the data folder, readable by its owner only; it is never answered, logged or stored anywhere else.

state.description: GET /api/v1/notify/telegram, and the answer of POST /recheck: the bot, whether a chat is bound, the link's state, the topics, the outbox's counts and a one-touch set-up in progress.

bot.description: The bot's @username; null when none is kept.

bound.description: A chat was bound by /start <nonce> and messages go to it.

state.description: blocked: the owner blocked the bot, sending waits until they write to it; token-invalid: Telegram refused the token; polling-stopped: another copy of the runtime reads this bot (Re-check restarts it).

topics.description: Messages go to the three topics (Orders, Bots, Account); false: one chat.

dropped.description: Messages given up, each with its reason (the health line).

pairing.description: The one-touch set-up's state (telegram-relay.schema.json); null where it is not available.

paired.description: POST /api/v1/notify/telegram/pair: Telegram's create link to open (d11 (a)). 422 {error, code} when one touch is not available: `code` is `one-touch`.

linked.description: POST /api/v1/notify/telegram/token: the bot Telegram accepted. 422 {error, code} when it refused the token or did not answer: `code` is `token-invalid` (Telegram refused it), `unknown` (Telegram did not answer) or `not-saved` (the token could not be kept where gcx runs); `error` is the English sentence, `code` is what the panel words.

startLink.description: POST /api/v1/notify/telegram/start: "Open your bot": https://t.me/<bot>?start=<nonce>, the nonce single-use for 10 minutes (only its hash is kept). 404 when no bot is kept.

sample.description: The body of POST /api/v1/dev/telegram/send (ruling 82, the Internal build only): the template to send with demo data, one of the `template` values of GET /api/v1/dev/telegram/samples.

samples.description: GET /api/v1/dev/telegram/samples (ruling 82, the Internal build only; 404 on every other tier): every message with demo data, its title and first line in the person's language, in the order of the three groups (manual: Orders, bots: Bots, account: Account).

line.description: The message's first line of text under its title; titles alone repeat, title and line do not.

sent.description: POST /api/v1/dev/telegram/send: the sample went into the outbox, to its topic. 422 {error, code} when no chat is linked: `code` is `not-linked`; 404 for an unknown template or on a tier other than Internal.
